# pltr data-health

Manage data health checks and reports

6 commands. Shared options (`--profile`, `--format`, `--output`, `--yes`, paging) are left out; [index.md](../index.md) explains the labels. Every option of one command: `pltr commands show <command>`.

## pltr data-health check

Create, inspect, replace and delete checks

### pltr data-health check create

[beta] Create a check.

`pltr data-health check create CONFIG [OPTIONS]`

- `CONFIG`: Check configuration as JSON or @file.json; the subject's datasetRid can be a Compass path (see below).
- `--intent`, `-i` TEXT: Why the check was set up.
- beta · SDK: `data_health.Check.create`

### pltr data-health check delete

[beta] Delete a check.

`pltr data-health check delete CHECK_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `CHECK_RID`: Check RID (ri.data-health.main.check.<id>).
- beta · **destructive** (asks first; `--yes` skips) · SDK: `data_health.Check.delete`

- beta · SDK: `data_health.Check.get`

### pltr data-health check replace

[beta] Replace a check's configuration.

## pltr data-health report

Inspect the reports (results) of checks

### pltr data-health report get

[beta] Get one report of a check: its result status and message.

`pltr data-health report get CHECK_RID CHECK_REPORT_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `CHECK_RID`: Check RID (ri.data-health.main.check.<id>).
- `CHECK_REPORT_RID`: Check report RID (find it with 'pltr data-health report latest <CHECK_RID>').
- beta · SDK: `data_health.Check.CheckReport.get`

### pltr data-health report latest

[beta] List a check's most recent reports.

`pltr data-health report latest CHECK_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `CHECK_RID`: Check RID (ri.data-health.main.check.<id>).
- `--limit` INTEGER: Maximum number of reports (the API's default is 10).
- beta · SDK: `data_health.Check.CheckReport.get_latest`
